description: Draft catalog of the mandatory blockers that GOV-000 section 10, GOV-022 section 22 and GOV-023 section 28 already require. Every control quotes one bullet of those lists verbatim. All controls are DRAFT with unassigned owners pending leadership approval; none has an automated verifier yet.

controls.title: Blocker: authentication bypass
controls.description: Production approval must be blocked, unless formally waived by the authorized engineering authority (GOV-000 section 10), when this is present: authentication bypass.
